rationale: This is an incremental variant of the already-evaluated "EBITDA Coverage Of Near-Term Obligations" (same rank-of-winsorized coverage ratio, minus a harmless double count, plus cash), and the numerator now mixes a flow (oibdp) with a stock (che) against a mixed flow/stock denominator, so the "true survival capacity" interpretation is dimensionally muddled rather than sharpened.

The earnings-minus-cash-flow wedge scaled by assets is the accrual anomaly (Sloan 1996) and its amplification in financially constrained/distressed firms is itself documented, and the [0,1] leverage rank multiplier compresses low-leverage firms toward zero — exactly the mid-portfolio pile-up the author blames for the gen-0 failures.

target_name: Profitability Without A Working Capital Buffer
rationale: Structurally this is the archived "Distress-Amplified Operating Profitability" with the re<0 gate swapped for a wcap<0 gate and the additive base term dropped, so the vast majority of firms take the value exactly zero and the sort will be dominated by a tie block rather than by the claimed within-state profitability bet.

MIN over two industry ranks is a legitimate non-substitutable conjunctive construct that is not spanned by additive quality composites and is robust to the wcap/lt denominator problems, though its high correlation with the simple average of the two ranks means the incremental information may prove small.

target_name: Margin Gain Net Of Liability Build
rationale: The two differenced components are not put on comparable scales, and since year-over-year Δ(lt/at) has far greater cross-sectional dispersion than Δ(oibdp/at), the signal will in practice be a deleveraging/debt-issuance sort — a known financing anomaly — rather than the balanced joint-transition measure the hypothesis describes.

Downside (trough) coverage is a genuinely different construct from the failed volatility×leverage product and is economically well motivated, but note that TS_MIN of an unscaled dollar EBITDA over five years will often just select the earliest year for growing firms, so the signal partly proxies growth/staleness and should be diagnosed against current-year coverage.
